resources.string:
This puts Afnon on your Android TV from your phone, no computer needed. First, let the TV accept installs over Wi-Fi:

1. On the TV, open Settings → System → About.
2. Go down to “Android TV OS build” (or “Build”) and press OK on it 7 times, until it says you are now a developer.
3. Go back to Settings → System → Developer options.
4. Turn on “USB debugging”. Some TVs call it “ADB debugging” or “Network debugging”.
5. If you also see “Wireless debugging” (Android 11 and later), turn it on too.
6. Keep the TV and this phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Searching this Wi-Fi. Tap your TV when it appears.
This phone isn’t on Wi-Fi. Join the same Wi-Fi as the TV, then try again.

On the TV: Settings → Network & Internet → your Wi-Fi shows its IP address. Wireless debugging also shows “IP address & Port”: type both, like 192.168.1.50:41234. With only the IP address, every port is checked.
Checking every port on %1$s. This takes about 15 seconds.
No debugging port is open on %1$s. Check that USB debugging or Wireless debugging is on.
Look at the TV: “Allow USB debugging?” appears. Tick “Always allow from this computer”, then choose Allow.
The TV didn’t allow this phone. Try again and choose Allow on the TV.

On the TV: Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging → “Pair device with pairing code”. Type the six-digit code it shows. The pairing port fills in by itself; if it doesn’t, type the port after the colon under “IP address & Port” in that same dialog.
Type the six-digit code and the pairing port.
Pairing didn’t work (%1$s). Open the pairing dialog again on the TV and type the new code.
Afnon needs Android 8 or later on the TV.
Another copy of Afnon is on the TV
It was signed with a different key, so it can’t be updated in place. Removing it also removes its settings (city, favourites, adhan choices). Remove it and install the latest?
Remote buttons and the call to prayer
Starts by itself after a restart
Quran Radio level bars and sleep timer
Afnon is installed, with a problem
Afnon %1$s is installed and set up. You can turn USB debugging and Wireless debugging off on the TV now. To update later, turn debugging back on and run this app again.
Afnon is installed and set up. You can turn USB debugging and Wireless debugging off on the TV now. To update later, turn debugging back on and run this app again.
Couldn’t connect to the TV (%1$s). Check that it’s on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that debugging is on.
